Power 5 Extract – 120 Capsules McMyco Power 5 Mushroom Extract – 120 Caps

Best capsule size for microdosing Number of capsules: 120 capsules

Capsule size: Size 0

Net Content Capsules: 525mg

Dosage: Take 1 – 2 capsules twice a day with water during the meal.

Best turkey tail mushroom extract Product Description | Power 5 Mushroom Extract – 120 Capsules:

McMyco Power 5 contains extracts of five of the most extraordinary mushrooms nature has to offer. Traditionally, these medicinal mushrooms have been used for various purposes for centuries (sometimes even thousands of years). And now, after all these years, it appears that the enthusiasm of our ancestors was more than justified. We simply can no longer ignore the special effect of these mushrooms!

McMyco Power 5 Mushroom Extract – 120 Caps contains the following five powerful mushrooms:

Chaga:

Chaga (Nonotus Obliquus) is nicknamed the black gold. This mushroom does especially well in cold regions. That is why you mainly find it in areas such as Canada, Siberia and Northern Europe. From the outside, this black fungus looks like burnt wood (charcoal), but inside it radiates.

Cordyceps Military:

Cordyceps is a mushroom with perhaps the most interesting history. Originally, it only grew on the backs of insects, hence the nickname caterpillar killer. Fortunately, a specific variant, the Cordyceps Militaris, can also be grown on a natural nutrient medium. We also use it in the vegan-friendly Power 5 formula.

Lion’s Mane:

Lion’s Mane, or Hericium Erinaceus, is a unique medicinal mushroom. We also know this white fungus as wig fungus and has been nicknamed “nature’s nutrient for the neurons”. This mushroom is also often use as a additional supplement during microdosing.

Reishi:

Reishi (Ganoderma Lucidum) has been use in China for over 2000 years. They know it there as Lingzhi and mushroom of immortality. A special nickname for a special fungus! Mycologists from all over the world are full of praise for this brown-red mushroom that should not be mis in our Power 5 formula.

Turkey Tail:

Turkey Tail (Trametes/Coriolus Versicolor) is a mushroom with an almost legendary status. In China and Japan they have been big fans of this fungus for centuries. The main reason is the presence of PSK and PSP, to which some special properties are link. The Turkey Tail is also getting more and more attention in Europe, for example you can know it from the movie Fantastic Fungi.

For extra effectiveness, the capsules were enrich with Vitamin C and Zinc. Both Vitamin C and Zinc support the immune system and the body’s defenses.

Ingredients per vegetarian capsule:  100mg Organic Reishi (Ganoderma Lucidum), 100mg Cordyceps Militaris, 100mg Lion’s Mane (Hericium Erinaceus), 100mg Chaga (Inonotus Obliquus), 100mg Turkey Tail 100% Fruit Body Extract. 15mg Vitamin C, 10mg Zinc. Excipient: magnesium citrate.

Shroom capsules warning | Power 5 Mushroom Extract – 120 Capsules :

Power 5 from McMyco is a dietary supplement and should be use as such. Do not exceed the recommended daily amount. Keep the product out of the reach of children. Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have health problems. Store at room temperature in a dark place.
